correctness.rationale: PASS: Parameter z=h²>1 with triangle vertices (-1,0),(1,0),(0,h) and farthest orthogonal projections to other edge lines, ties fixed. Six directed affine side-coordinate projection formulas follow from dot products. For the orientation 012 the candidate triple has coordinates (2,2,z-1)/(z+3), whose strict squared-distance comparisons are positive exactly 1<z<3+2sqrt3, with reflected 021 a distinct attracting three-cycle. The itinerary 0102 has unique affine fixed point (1,2,z+1,z)/(z+2), margin sign controlled by z²-z-1, hence exists precisely 1<z<phi and has return multiplier 1/(z+1)². The 01210212 eight-visit candidate has coordinates with D=z³+4z²+z+2; two margin types always positive on 1<z<b, R(z)<0 there, while the remaining margin has sign of Q=z^5-5z^4-5z^3-4z²-2z-1 with exactly one positive root r~5.961497898. Therefore r<z<b is exactly the eight-branch interval within the three-cycle regime. Distinct primitive side words and contracting affine returns give >=3 locally attracting periodic orbits in each disjoint open window; no census of other orbits claimed. Independent exact rational projection tests 20 checks corroborate margin/legal itineraries; finite checking alone is not proof of all z.
